prompt: Design a modular Distributed Key-Value Store in Python with three decoupled layers: (1) Consistent Hashing Ring router distributing keys across virtual nodes, (2) Storage Engine maintaining LSM-Tree memtables and SSTable disk flushes, and (3) Anti-Entropy Repair Subsystem utilizing Merkle trees to synchronize divergent replicas.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Hashing Score: 0-5 (Evaluates consistent hash ring implementation and virtual nodes)
Module 2 Storage Score: 0-5 (Evaluates LSM-tree memtable and SSTable management)
Module 3 Entropy Score: 0-5 (Evaluates Merkle tree calculation and replica reconciliation)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates cluster communication and data consistency)
